subject.title: [Feishu] 飞书群多机器人身份混乱问题

question: Should Feishu group sessions include a stable account/app identity component, and what migration contract should existing Feishu group sessions use?
rationale: The source-level bug is clear, but changing durable session identity affects stored transcripts, conversation bindings, last-route metadata, message delivery identity, and security boundaries, so automation should not choose the permanent contract alone.

options.title: Account-scope Feishu group sessions
options.body: Make Feishu group session identity include stable account/app identity and ship doctor migration plus upgrade proof.

options.title: Document shared-session limitation
options.body: Keep current shared group sessions and document that multiple Feishu bot apps in one group must route to distinct agents or accept shared context.

options.title: Add opt-in isolation first
options.body: Preserve current default keys and add a Feishu-owned isolation mode while maintainers collect upgrade evidence for a future default change.

recommendation.title: Account-scope Feishu group sessions
recommendation.body: Make Feishu group session identity include stable account/app identity and ship doctor migration plus upgrade proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The Feishu package and plugin manifest identify this handle as the Feishu/Lark plugin ownership signal, and the decision is Feishu-specific.
